## SPX Boosts 2025 Adjusted EBITDA Guidance 15% on Strong Q1 Performance

## Summary

SPX Technologies reported a strong start to 2025, marked by double-digit growth in key profit metrics and an optimistic outlook for the full year. For the first quarter ended March 29, 2025, the company saw Adjusted EPS jump 10.4% to $1.38 and Adjusted EBITDA climb 11.5% to $102.6 million, significantly outpacing the 3.7% increase in total revenue to $482.6 million.

This performance was underpinned by notable margin expansion, particularly within the Detection & Measurement segment, which saw its segment income margin rise by 360 basis points. The HVAC segment also contributed with a 30 basis point margin improvement. While the Detection & Measurement segment experienced an organic revenue decline, the HVAC segment posted solid organic growth, attributed partly to a return to more typical heating product volumes compared to a mild prior year.

The quarter also saw a substantial increase in total debt, rising by $346 million to $960 million compared to the end of 2024. This increase primarily funded business acquisitions, which totaled $304 million (net of cash acquired) in investing activities. The company highlighted the recent acquisition of Sigma & Omega, which is expected to strengthen the HVAC segment and is included in the updated full-year guidance.

Based on the solid first quarter results and the impact of recent strategic actions, SPX raised its full-year 2025 guidance for revenue, Adjusted EBITDA, and Adjusted EPS. The midpoint of the updated Adjusted EBITDA forecast now implies a year-over-year increase of approximately 15%. The revised guidance ranges also incorporate the net impact of announced tariffs and associated mitigation efforts, including price adjustments.
